algorithm: The original base_stock level of 100 appears too low given the demand patterns. Analyzing the historical trajectories, demand frequently exceeds 100 with many periods above 110-120. With lost sales cost (p=2) being twice the holding cost (h=1), it's more cost-effective to carry slightly more inventory to avoid stockouts. Increasing base_stock to 125 provides better coverage for high-demand periods while staying within reasonable bounds given the cost structure. This adjustment should reduce lost sales costs more than it increases holding costs, improving overall performance.
